cat > /tmp/patch_rsft.py << 'PYEOF'
import re

path = "/root/autodl-tmp/freige/training/rsft_generate.py"
with open(path) as f:
    code = f.read()

# 1. Change --shard_id from str to int, add --num_shards
old_shard = '''    parser.add_argument("--shard_id", type=str, default="",
                        help="Shard identifier, appended to output filename")'''
new_shard = '''    parser.add_argument("--shard_id", type=int, default=0,
                        help="Shard index for parallel generation")
    parser.add_argument("--num_shards", type=int, default=1,
                        help="Total number of shards for parallel generation")'''
assert old_shard in code, "shard_id pattern not found"
code = code.replace(old_shard, new_shard)

# 2. Change output dir logic: use shard subdirectory
old_output = '''    output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if args.shard_id:
        output_file = output_dir / f"generations_shard{args.shard_id}.jsonl"
    else:
        output_file = output_dir / "generations.jsonl"'''
new_output = '''    if args.num_shards > 1:
        output_dir = Path(args.output_dir) / f"shard_{args.shard_id}"
    else:
        output_dir = Path(args.output_dir)
    output_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    output_file = output_dir / "generations.jsonl"'''
assert old_output in code, "output dir pattern not found"
code = code.replace(old_output, new_output)

# 3. Replace slicing logic with num_shards-based auto-slicing
old_slice = '''    if args.end_idx > 0:
        items = items[args.start_idx:args.end_idx]
    elif args.start_idx > 0:
        items = items[args.start_idx:]
    logger.info("Shard slice: [%d:%s] -> %d documents",
                args.start_idx, str(args.end_idx) if args.end_idx > 0 else "end", len(items))'''
new_slice = '''    if args.num_shards > 1:
        total = len(items)
        per_shard = total // args.num_shards
        start = args.shard_id * per_shard
        end = start + per_shard if args.shard_id < args.num_shards - 1 else total
        items = items[start:end]
        logger.info("Shard %d/%d: docs [%d:%d] -> %d documents",
                    args.shard_id, args.num_shards, start, end, len(items))
    elif args.end_idx > 0:
        items = items[args.start_idx:args.end_idx]
        logger.info("Slice: [%d:%d] -> %d documents", args.start_idx, args.end_idx, len(items))
    elif args.start_idx > 0:
        items = items[args.start_idx:]
        logger.info("Slice: [%d:end] -> %d documents", args.start_idx, len(items))
    else:
        logger.info("Full dataset: %d documents", len(items))'''
assert old_slice in code, "slice pattern not found"
code = code.replace(old_slice, new_slice)

# 4. Fix progress paths to use output_dir (Path) instead of args.output_dir (str)
code = code.replace('completed = load_progress(args.output_dir)', 'completed = load_progress(output_dir)')
code = code.replace('save_progress(args.output_dir, completed)', 'save_progress(output_dir, completed)')

with open(path, 'w') as f:
    f.write(code)

print("OK: all patches applied")
